status: ALTERNATIVE for the advisors: same as trigger_v1.json but judged over a rolling 10-minute window
notes: An operator fails a service when at least 10% of its usable checks in the last 10 minutes failed. At 6 checks a minute that is 6 of 60 calls; normal AWS error rates are far below that, so two operators crossing it together by chance is very unlikely.
Reference networks (the AWS Lambda probe in Oregon) are shown on the dashboard but never counted: a probe inside AWS can't independently judge AWS.

Two definitions are reported side by side. 'degraded' (the rolling 10% rule above) catches partial outages; 'hard_down' matches the 'no service' style of trigger used in current parametric cloud policies. The top-level window settings are the 'degraded' definition.

degraded.label: Degraded
degraded.description: At least 2 independent companies each see 10% or more of their calls to a service fail over the last 10 minutes.

hard_down.label: Hard down
hard_down.description: At least 2 independent companies each see 90% or more of their calls to a service fail over the last 3 minutes: no usable service.
